profile.org_note: A Hunt Companies subsidiary since early October 2025. The company site names only two executives (CEO and CFO) and a four-person board made up entirely of Hunt Companies executives, so land and capital decisions most likely run through the CEO, the CFO and that Hunt board; Hunt's holdings page says View Homes runs five divisions across Colorado, Texas and New Mexico but no division or land leader is named publicly. Entity name: the Hunt-hosted job board says 'View Homes, LLC' while the website contact form still says 'View Homes, Inc.'. Main phone shown is the Colorado Springs office line at the HQ address; the site publishes one phone per region and no corporate switchboard.
profile.summary: Entry-level and first-move-up for-sale homebuilder (a Builder 100 company, per its parent), headquartered in Colorado Springs and selling in eight markets across Colorado, New Mexico and Texas, with about 33 community pages on its site in November 2026. El Paso-based Hunt Companies took control in early October 2025 (terms undisclosed); Natasha Gandhi succeeded founder Randy O'Leary as CEO in March 2026 and the board is now all Hunt executives. Legacy regional brands (Desert View, Aspen View, Horizon View) are being folded into a single View Homes brand; trade press also reports franchise-style operations in Iowa and South Dakota that are not on the current community list.
